dataset_rules_check.name: dataset_rules_check
dataset_rules_check.value: "dataset_versions"."rules_version" IN ('v1','v2','v3') AND ("dataset_versions"."rules_version"='v1' OR "dataset_versions"."pole_audit_id" IS NOT NULL)

stats_nonnegative_check.name: stats_nonnegative_check
stats_nonnegative_check.value: ("driver_stats"."championships" IS NULL OR "driver_stats"."championships" >= 0) AND ("driver_stats"."wins" IS NULL OR "driver_stats"."wins" >= 0) AND ("driver_stats"."podiums" IS NULL OR "driver_stats"."podiums" >= 0) AND ("driver_stats"."race_starts" IS NULL OR "driver_stats"."race_starts" >= 0)

stats_eligible_check.name: stats_eligible_check
stats_eligible_check.value: NOT "driver_stats"."eligible" OR ("driver_stats"."debut_year" IS NOT NULL AND "driver_stats"."last_start_year" IS NOT NULL AND "driver_stats"."race_starts" > 0 AND "driver_stats"."championships" IS NOT NULL AND "driver_stats"."wins" IS NOT NULL AND "driver_stats"."podiums" IS NOT NULL AND "driver_stats"."constructor_ids" IS NOT NULL AND "driver_stats"."active_decades" IS NOT NULL)

game_attempts_check.name: game_attempts_check
game_attempts_check.value: "game_sessions"."attempts_used" >= 0 AND "game_sessions"."attempts_used" <= "game_sessions"."max_attempts" AND (("game_sessions"."difficulty" IN ('beginner','normal') AND "game_sessions"."max_attempts"=8) OR ("game_sessions"."difficulty"='historical' AND "game_sessions"."max_attempts"=10))

game_state_check.name: game_state_check
game_state_check.value: ("game_sessions"."status" IN ('active','playing') AND "game_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "game_sessions"."attempts_used"<"game_sessions"."max_attempts") OR ("game_sessions"."status"='won' AND "game_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "game_sessions"."attempts_used">0) OR ("game_sessions"."status"='lost' AND "game_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "game_sessions"."attempts_used"="game_sessions"."max_attempts") OR ("game_sessions"."status"='revealed' AND "game_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "game_sessions"."attempts_used"<"game_sessions"."max_attempts")

game_rules_check.name: game_rules_check
game_rules_check.value: "game_sessions"."rules_version" IN ('v1','v2','v3') AND ("game_sessions"."status"<>'active' OR "game_sessions"."rules_version"='v1') AND ("game_sessions"."status"<>'playing' OR "game_sessions"."rules_version" IN ('v2','v3'))
